ledger.x: 1974: Niue becomes self-governing in free association with New Zealand: infobox 'Self-government in free association with New Zealand: 19 October 1974'; the page also says Niue has been self-governing 'since 3 September 1974, when the people endorsed the Constitution in a plebiscite'.

certainty.note: A single island; the border is the coast.
